entries.wording: Receive item at office of exchange (Inb)
entries.note: The item reached Zimpost's office of exchange from abroad.
Zimpost presented the item to customs.
The office that delivers the item, or keeps it for collection, received it.
An office on the way to the delivery office received the item.
An office sent the item on within Zimbabwe.
Customs released the item into Zimpost's network; it is not a return to the sender.
